title: Product Card
description: One product as a card, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: the product's image with an optional Badge on it, its linked name, a short description, the price (with the old price struck through on a sale) and an Add to cart button, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the image moves beside the text at @sm, the name steps up at @md, and the image and the text share the width evenly, the image square, at @lg.
